[USER] User asked for suggestions on how to store cucumbers to keep them fresh for a longer period.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for storing cucumbers:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Refrigerate them below 40°F (4°C).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Store in a breathable container (paper bag, mesh bag, or ventilated plastic bag).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Keep them dry before storing.
